newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa futures called to open up $15 to $20.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa futures called to open up $15 to $20.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open up $15 to $20 Thursday as the London market reversed its initial weakness to move higher on shortcovering, traders said.
A lack of follow-through selling in LIFFE's May contract prompted the shortcovering, traders added. The overnight market also absorbed origin selling.
Wednesday, CSCE cocoa prices ended unchanged after an early rally to a one-month highs was met with heavy trade selling.
Most-active May futures closed at $1,336 a tonne, unchanged from the previous day, having traded between $1,326 and $1,352 a tonne.
